reviews.author: frugal1
reviews.review_text:
I'm simply sharing my feedback so new potential renters don't make the same mistake. Before moving into Elliot's Crossing After being a resident at this apartment for over 7 months, and any positive review couldn't be more fabricated. I invite to you to take a walk on premise and see for yourself

The only positive thing I can think of is maintenance has always been responsive.

Saftey is a concern. Check the Tempe Police website. Garden Grove Apartments ,which is just across the street , is the number 1 police callout in Tempe and some of the toxicity has spilled over into Elliot crossing ungated community.  I've had other residents mentioned their cars have been broken into and  police visit the premises a lot.

The pictures online are deceiving. I'm afraid to invite guest over. The grounds are dirty. Dog mess is everywhere. When summer ends and the jet engine a/c units stop blasting, every conversation from the neighboring apartments can be heard. Drama and arguments have played out in my bed room at night.  Outside noise goes on from outside at all hours of the day and night as well. Ear plugs have not helped. There have been various reviews of cockroaches (which they call waterbugs) and termites infesting the dwellings. I'm sad to confirm those reports are true. I have taken several pictures I can show.

 Management is delusional if they think this apartment complex is great. Ownership has changed several hands and rent has perpetually increased without improving the quality of living for the residents. Management is also very lenient of the noise and does not enforce policies for the number of roommates living in one apartment unit. The management has done a very poor job displaying speed limits in the parking lot; a catastrophe waiting to happen..

As working residents we don't ask for me much; just a quiet, safe, and clean apartment dwelling. I've spoken up the chain in several cases and no action has been done.  If you're a member of Elliot Crossing Apartment management and reading this, I do have some advice . Instead replying with more broken promises, please actually do something tangible. Start by sending a letter out to all your residents with a plan to improve the quality of living and remind all residents of the rules they signed in their lease. Loud noise, parties, and dog mess are unacceptable. Invest in a noise reducing barriers and a security gate; I'm sure an apartment community with 2 pools and over hedged apartment rent can afford it.

reviews.author: bmckennaaz

Not really anything super awesome about it, but after living in and around Tempe for the last 8 years, i finally don't have a complaint about where i live. The manager is nice and does a good job - if a little would rub off on his staff, that would be nice. The apartment is very quiet, lots of friendly people, room to maneuver, the whole shabang. reviews.author: Current Resident 204703
reviews.review_text: A transitional home for me. The property is older (built in the early 80's), and while they are renovating many of the apartments (mine included) remain dated. The infrastructure of the property remains dated. AC unites are old and you can tell the seasons by the number service men repairing AC units. Not well insulated, so expect to see that in your electric bill. Lots of green space, however. Parking is nightmare for the east side of the property, particularly after they built a "soccer pitch," a nice amenity for families but one that will be under used in context of the inconvenience created for many residents. The staff is hit or miss. While I've had a generally positive experience working with the leasing and maintenance staff, I know others have not.

reviews.author: Current Resident 543536
reviews.review_title: Just about everything that could go wrong did!
reviews.review_text: Lets start with the apartment itself. The noise in the apartments travels through walls as if they were paper. If you are unlucky, you get stuck on the 1st floor where you can hear your upstairs neighbors daily rituals and relish the time they are away. If you are extremely unlucky and live in apt 103 you will be able to hear everything (sounds of the bathroom). The lady that lives up above has been there for approx 13 years, weighs over 300 lbs, and rarely leaves home. One would think a 300+ lb lady would not be 300+ lbs with the amount of movement she makes on a daily basis, but I can only assume it is from excess trips to the fridge. The office staff has completely changed with the exception of the property manger, Joanne. If anything goes wrong (and it will), it will be pulling teeth to get it straightened out. I had a sewage flood in my apartment and we had to fight to get a hotel stay, and it took 3 days to clean the place. The A/C went out (in the summer) and we had to fight to get a hotel stay. Apparently there is an unwritten rule that the temperature inside your apartment has to exceed 90 to get a free hotel stay, but luckily enough it got up to 91. My car was towed to repave the lot without notice. They give out these little stickers to identify your car but when I asked the Joanne about them she said they don´t even keep the records. I guess it is to give you an initial sense of security when you move in. I had to complain about the "large woman" that lurked above me for the duration of the lease, and notices were issued but no action was ever taken. Once the "large woman" above realized we were complaining about her, she started to complain about us and Joanne just let it go on and on. The maintenance staff is the shining jewel. About 80% of all issues were resolved quickly and were done right the first time. Parking is horrible if you live on the north side of the property unless you want to pay $15 a month for a covered spot. If you live there a year, almost all your neighbors will change (except for 300+ lb neighbors above you), the office staff will all change, some major appliance will break, and you will always hear a party, a dog, or screaming kids. My advice, stay away.....FAR AWAY!

reviews.author: Former Resident 824811
reviews.review_text: The staff lies to you. The staff covers up the truth. Corporate sides with their staff without having a conversation with you about the situation and hearing your side. They fill out a move out charges worksheet and then days later destroy the original one, recreate a similar one, and add nearly $100 to the total from the original sheet. and claim the total on the fraudulent sheet are "standard fees." If they are standard fees then why the heck were they not put on my 1st move out charge sheet that was destroyed and recreated. Luckily for me I made a copy of the original one. Then when confronted about this they tell that you should've signed a paper stating the standard fees and acknowledge that you were never given this sheet, never signed it, never saw it, and still proceed to charge you the "standard fees" that you knew nothing about and acknowledge they failed to disclose them to you. Additionally, I was promised a rent rate that I agreed with and applied for. I dove 3 days cross country just to arrive to sign my lease and they increased my rent nearly $200 a month and claimed it was because of "market value." Again corporate refused to honor the original agreed upon rent price so I got screwed by them the day I got here. SOUNDS LIKE A CROOKED BUSINESS AND SHADY BUSINESS PRACTICES TO ME AND YOU NEED TO FIND SOMEWHERE ELSE TO LIVE. Unless of course you like being lied to, taken advantage of, being ignored by corporate staff, and having fraudulent documents created to support their outrages lies. I have attached the charge worksheets (original and fraudulent one) for your convenience to prove that I am not just making this up. Pay particular attention to the handwriting as they are different, the date is different, the original charges are scratched out and the 35 dollar fee is changed to a 75 dollar fee. If they claim the 85 and 75 are "standard fees" then why are they not listed on the sheet as such, why were they not listed on my original sheet, and why did they feel the need to destroy the original cost sheet and recreate a similar one?

reviews.author: Current Resident 785485
reviews.review_text: Uncovered parking is an absolute nightmare in the summer!  Management was very friendly, but often quite slow to fix things.  Pool is very nice!  Three times during my three years of living there, I got knocks on the door at 2 in the morning looking for someone who wasn't there.  They were obviously looking for drugs, and it freaked me out.  The thing that made me move out, however, was the HORRIBLE cable system!  They have "TV Max" cabe, which only has 60 or so channels, and they are low-tier channels (honestly, who wants The International Channel?).  Never had a problem with roaches, as previous posts screamed about.  Also, got a little concerned with the high voltage wires running through the parking lot.  It messed with my radio reception, and I have to wonder if it messed with my health.  There is not a grocery store nearby!  The nearest ones are at Guadalupe and Rural, Elliot and McClintock, or Eliot and 48th Street.  Doesn't make for a quick trip to the store!

reviews.author: Former Resident 777660
reviews.review_text: This place deserves zero stars Do not rent here! The apartments are not nice enough to compensate for the heinous apartment managers. They are absolutely the worst! Every time you walked down there, it was being staffed by a whole new set of people. They probably went through a million employees in the whole two years we were there. They were really good at promising anything and everything to you, and then when you came back to ask about it, all we got was "Well who told you that? That's not right." If you are going to live here, get EVERYTHING THEY SAY IN WRITING! The grounds crew are there cleaning the grounds every single morning, so say good bye to hearing anything from 7-9am, the pool during the summer is disgusting! Hopefully you're one of the first few swims of the week, but then someone is guaranteed to POOP in it (happened both summers we were there), and it won't be cleaned for about two weeks. There were cockroaches in our bathrooms, and the toilets overflowed regularly. (be prepared to use only 1-2 squares when using the facilities). Lastly, the move out. I was told by one of the front people (who knows which one, they're probably gone by now), that we could get a free cup of touch up paint. When I went to collect I waited 5 HOURS for them to contact the head maintenance man, because only one person in the whole damn place had access to the magical unattainable paint. I finally lost my patience and went to figure it out myself, and it turns out they didn't carry the color of paint that I needed. cool. We also cleaned and scrubbed that apartment for two days. Two whole days. We bought special cleaners, and scrubbers, and that place looked amazing! At least better than when we moved in (there was a visible dirty foot print on the wall). We were charged almost $300 in cleaning fees. $300?!?!? Absolutely ridiculous. I have lived in a total of 7 apartments, and these people were by far the worst. Do not rent here. Do not work here. Stay as far away as you can and pray for the poor souls who still live there.

reviews.author: Current Resident 873895
reviews.review_text: By far the worst apartment complex I have ever lived in. Been here for about a year, moving out on January first thank god. First of all, there are notices on everyone's door about once a month for "annual" maintenance inspections.  They give you a days notice that someone will be coming into your apartment at any given time throughout the day. It feels like a violation of privacy,  I understand maybe once a year but this has happened almost every month since I've lived here. Then there's the fact that on two separate occasions I've been walking down the stairs only to find that the concrete stairs are completely broken in half, like there's a whole stair missing. It's extremely dangerous.  The one that's busted now has been this way for two weeks, they finally just put caution tape up around it. God forbid anyone is walking underneath one if them when another one breaks. You would literally die or have a serious concussion. Then there's the fact that there are constant police stand offs and situations in this area, two people got shot across the street a few weeks ago,  another person got shot just a short time before that. Also, there are people smoking pot pretty much on a daily basis on their patios, which wouldn't be so bad if I didn't have to go out onto MY patio to do my laundry and smell their bad decisions. Especially since I'm pregnant.  Lastly,  they've been painting the whole complex for the last few months and they start outside slamming ladders on the side of the buildings at 7 am. I honestly feel like they try to be as absolutely loud as possible. I hate this place to the core, heed my advice..... look elsewhere!

reviews.author: Current Resident 535120
reviews.review_text:
There is nothing better than walking into a clean community. It shows just how much the staff takes care of the place. The community is very green and well kept. The staff is nothing short of kind and generous. I'm moving out this month and I'm sorry to go. This community is very great, it's a hidden gem in the uglyness that Tempe, AZ can sometimes be. You'll feel it too the moment you walk through the doors. The manager is always making conversation with his residents and always seems to be in a good mood. His assistant is the exact same way, she actually cares about the residents and isn't just out for the money, the leasing girl has always been very nice to me as well! I wandered on this site the other day and felt that I needed to post something positive amongst all this cruelty. 

Rent at Pinnacle Grove, you won't be dissappointed.

reviews.author: Current Resident 740889
reviews.review_title: My Home Away From Home II (STAY AWAY!!!)
reviews.review_text: I am the person that wrote the posting "My Home Away From Home" in October of 2006. It is now November and do I ever have a change of heart about this place!!! After I posted the 1st comment, I noticed that there was a leaky water sprinkler in my walk-in closet. I have told management about this SEVERAL times and the issue has yet to be resolved. On 11/17 I was in my closet and was getting my luggage for a vacation in Sedona. My luggage was sopping wet & FULL OF MOLD!!! I have told management about this several times and they claim they have told maintenance but now my walk-in closet looks like something from a movie! There is MOLD everywhere... on the walls, on the ceiling, on clothes and my luggage.  Luckily I was able to get most of my stuff out of there before the mold ruined it, but my luggage & some clothes are not salvageable.  In addition to the mold, there are gnats... because of the stagnant water.  The apartment STINKS to high heaven because of the mold that grows larger on a daily basis. I have had to move out and stay with a friend because of the black mold infestation!  When I would stay at my apartment I would feel nauseous, feel fatigued, have headaches, ache all over and have asthma attacks.  On top of the leaking pipe issue, the grounds are over watered, causing pools of water to develop which are prime breeding grounds for pests & bugs. Other than the issues listed here, the place is quiet!  But please take my advice:  DO NOT RENT HERE!!! If you do, take a black light to shine on the walls & carpet.  If the carpet/walls glow a 'yellow' color then there is MOLD!!!

reviews.review_text: I have lived here for almost a year now and yes we live in the dreaded BACK END of the complex, but overall it is a decent place to live. I really appreciated the fact that they got around to putting up some brighter lights in the parking area because the old ones were pretty dim and visibilty was pretty poor. The fact that they make you pay for covered parking is pretty lame but then again, since not many people pay for covered parking, i think everyone pretty much has their own covered parking spot. Havent really had any bug problems since we moved in except for the ants outside, but thats their home, as long as they stay out of mine, im pretty content. Plus it goves you something to do on Saturday with your magnifying glass. No roaches or anything like that, mice, nothing. The garbage disposal broke a few times and water went everywhere, but we managed to fix it on our own with the exception of one time they had to call the rooter guy out so he could snake the line. He said its pretty common to find a lot of crap in the lines around apartments because people will run stuff down their garbage disposal thinking its will obliterate anything you stick in it when in fact he stated, "Most common apartment garbage disposals are not able to handle the amount or type of stuff common renters are convinced they can handle." Hence the reason I wasn´t too upset about the garbage disposal. (My girlfriend did put a lot of vegetable stuff down ours.) I rarely see the police here and when they are it´s usually only for a little while and then they are gone. I did however notice that when certian tenants left the complex, as in either evicted or otherwise, the police presence was a lot less. It seems to be a pretty low-crime area and the only thing you really have to worry about is the stinky dumpster when tempe´s finest trashmen decide to skip your dumpster, again, not the complex´s fault.

reviews.review_text: I moved into this complex in April 2018 and its been nothing but issues since day one. The apartment wasn't ready when I arrived after I let the office staff know what time I'd be arriving with a trailer from out of state. We had to wait 45 minutes before we could start unloading. More recently I've dealt with a leak from the apartments above that left brown/yellow water in my bathtub that took nearly a week to repair, which left me not able to use my apartment. The gym has 4 treadmills. Three are broken and one stops after 7 seconds. Residents leave beer bottles, used condoms, cigarette butts, and trash all over the grounds. Maintenance does not have a very good turn-around time and the staff is severely incompetent. No one can seem to take a message or assist in getting resolution to your problems and they leave promises unfulfilled. There is no compassion or empathy from anyone in the office, which makes it harder to deal with when this is supposed to be your HOME. I would not recommend these apartments, spend the extra money to have something that isn't falling apart and have staff on hand that are willing and understanding. I cannot wait until my lease is up. Big mistake!

Pro: convenient location to commute from

And everyone is sick of listening to me complain about how much I miss my wonderful old apartment at Elliot's Crossing!<br><br>I LOVED my apartment, very nice, clean, I lived in the front of the complex and never had a problem with parking.  Despite overlooking the pool noise was never an issue.  Management was always helpful and friendly and maintenance responded promptly to problems.  I feel I paid very low rent fo the quality that I got.<br><br>I can't say enough good things about this place and I would probably move back if I hadn't taken a job in another part of the valley.

reviews.author: Current Resident 506227
reviews.review_text: They have always been so helpful and so kind and always on top of everything for me. They're extremely professional and get the job done right the first time. Best complex I have ever moved into. Love Elliots crossing
reviews.response_text: Dear Resident, we're very happy to have you a part of our community! The team here at Elliot's Crossing is prepared to make your experience with us the best it possibly can be, so don't hesitate to reach out with any comments or feedback. Welcome home!

reviews.author: Current Resident 248924
reviews.review_text: The office staff was always nice and willing to help.  It was a pain sometimes trying to get direct answers or return calls without having to walk into the office and complain again but all in all my time here was pretty ok.  The maintenance department was always GREAT!
reviews.response_text: We understand if you are not completely satisfied looking back at your time with us. Our office staff is extremely busy and does their best to answer phone calls in a timely manner. We appreciate your feedback and will work on being more responsive in the future. We take pride in our friendly attitude and our willingness to help out our residents. It seems you have moved out, however, we wish you the best in your future endeavors.

reviews.author: LeeshaLuv
reviews.review_text: If there are maintenance problems give the repair guys time. I had some air conditioning issues at first but after some trial and error that I had to be patient through, I was able to get a new AC unit installed and the air is running great now. Very happy with how things are going!

reviews.author: eandj2006
reviews.review_text:
I have lived at Pinnacle for the last 4 years and my experience has been a good one so far. Even thought I live in one of the older apts, I have never had major problems. When my ac broke down I was offered another apt to sleep in and a brand new unit was put in.  I have never seen a roach in my apt or anywhere on the property. The place is quiet and so are the neighbors.  The staff enforces pet rules and have prepared a doggy park. 
True a new staff moved in and what has happened, is that they are a little over whelmed. They have taken on so much in such a short time span. They do need to work on their smiles: Not everyone that enters the office has a complaint. This doesn t mean that they are rude or unfriendly, they just seem apprehensive all the time.  Not everyone will be happy; we can t always choose the color of the apt because, we do not own the property. All I can say is that this is a great place to live. JM & EM :):):):):)

reviews.author: amaroconversion
reviews.review_text: I went into Pinnacle Grove last week and was toured by a really nice girl. I told her about the problems I had with an apartment I had moved into. She was very sympathetic and showed me various floor plans and practically showed me the whole complex. It didn't even feel like I was being toured by a boring/rude leasing agent, she truely cared for my needs and did her best to accommodate me. She got me moved in that same day and the apartment itself is really nice. I had a chance to speak with the manager who is also very nice and professional. I went back in because my garbage disposal wasn't working and the maintenance guy went that same day to fix it. The grounds are always kept so nice as well. I had such a positive experienced that I felt I needed to let people know. Also, don't take these negative reviews to seriously, if someone has a bad experience they're going to find an outlet but the people who have good experiences hardly go out of their way to let people know.

reviews.author: Current Resident 654677
reviews.review_text: Just recently moved in and so far I love it. The one bedrooms have plenty of space and storage. The community is quiet and everyone seems nice. Wish they had more covered parking and we're closer to the building I stay in.
reviews.response_text: We are so happy to hear that you are loving your new home! It is a true honor to have you in our community. Thank you for your review and please feel free to reach out if you should need anything at all. Welcome home!

reviews.author: Current Resident 161045
reviews.review_text:
The community has gone downhill since the recent merger with pinnacle grove. Some of the new staff members have no idea what they're doing. If I have to visit the office I pray that Ryan is working, he's always friendly and knowledgeable. 
My upstairs neighbors are incredibly loud. They constantly blast their stereo and television, sometimes until midnight. They must smoke a pack of cigarettes a day because you can hear the opening and slamming of their patio door every hour in addition to smelling the smoke drifting down to my apartment if I have the backdoor open. 
The apartment itself is pretty nice and a good size. The grounds are maintained well however, I could do without someone waking me up with a leaf blower at the crack of dawn. The pool and grilling area looks great. I wish the pool hours were still enforced. It's very noisy and people will swim until the early hours of the morning. I always have to watch for broken glass around the pool gate when I take my dog out because people can't seem to hold onto their beer bottles. 
I would still recommend the apartments to a friend.

reviews.review_text:
Overall the apartment appearance and the overall atmosphere is family-friendly and pretty nice. It has a pool and a few playground areas. 

My overall apartment experience has been somewhat negative though. Within the first few days of moving in I encountered two rather large roaches. After those were elminated and the apartment put some bate in my apartment, the cockroaches left basically permanently. 

A few months later though I had termites in one wall that the apartment did treat I think but I am not exactly sure how. I also had to deal with a rather large rat in my apartment which I killed myself with a trap I bought myself that same night. I went and showed the office a picture of it. 

I have also had some plumbing issues. The sink has issues with water falling back "into" the dishwasher causing it to pool and fester if you don't run the dishwasher. Also sometimes when turning on the bathtub the water turns black upon initial turn on and clears up shortly after. 

Overall I feel like I have spent too much money for how small and for what issues I have had.  

Interactions with the staff at the office have been good though, and they have always been friendly and accomodating as they possibly can be. And maintenance staff has come and done some repairs whenever requested so I can't complain there at all.
reviews.response_text: Hi there, it's wonderful to hear from you! Thank you for your compliments of our wonderful community. It is important that we provide you with the utmost comfort in your home and we would like to connect with you regarding the pest control option that we have for our residents. When you have a moment, please stop by our office so we can schedule the best time for us to assist you. Thank you for your review and we are honored to have you here at Elliot's Crossing!

reviews.author: Current Resident 160394
reviews.review_text: It has been great. A quiet community- my time here has been undisturbed and peaceful- not much more I can ask for. As soon as the new staff came in, the community seemed to run much more efficiently. What little problems I did have were always resolved quickly.

reviews.author: Current Resident 70002
reviews.review_text: I moved into Elliot's Crossing Apartment Homes in 2001, after moving to Arizona from the midwest.  I was impressed by the lush landscape, because it reminded me of home.  I lived at Elliot's Crossing for four years and loved the community so much.  I moved from there to be closer to my job and try to save some gas money.  Since then, I lived at two other communities and have never had the level of customer service that I experienced at Elliot's Crossing.  Last month, I made the decision to move back and to my surprise, many of the original office staff greeted and remembered me when I walked through the door, as well as many familiar residents that still live there.  I just thought that was amazing and wanted to share my story.  I highly recommend the family atmosphere and the incredible staff at Elliot's Crossing!

reviews.author: Current Resident 160317
reviews.review_text: Maintenance and office are the best!   Tenants are trash that are loud and harass others, background checks are minimal and this is the result.  I only had one attempted break in this year and not only will I not renew, I will be breaking my lease next week.  There are better places, avoid.

reviews.author: Cam2006
reviews.review_text: I lived here for a year and the apartment was nice and clean, I didn't have a roach problem, but the rest of the complex sucks. Now that I'm gone I'm at peace of mind.

reviews.author: Current Resident 160130
reviews.review_text: Great.  I have been here for 5 years.  It is a great location. Located near public transportation and many stores and shops.  Quiet area, low crime.  Generally good neighbors.  Pretty property.  Will sign another lease.

reviews.author: Current Resident 340398
reviews.review_text:
My husband & I lived here for a little over a year and at the beginning we didnt have any problems but a month after we moved in new management bouth it out; unknown to us. Six months later we got a notice saying that we owed over $900 because we never paid our security deposit and they have been charging us late fees on top of that every month and had not advised us until six months after we were already living there. I tried delaing with the rental office but every time I did i was told to deal with corporate. Corporate then toldus that it was oir resposibility toprove that we paid the security deposit not theirs; if we didnt pay how did we get the keys? went round and round for 2 more months. We ended up have to pay the security deposit again becuase we were trying to transfer. SO then everything got cleared up and our account was at a $0. When we got ready to transfer we were then told that we had to pay over $700 if we wanted to transfer to the other apt on top of the difference in the apartment prices; hence that day we put went out and found a new and much better place. Also the staff in the office doesnt know what they are doing becuase everyone in there will tell you a different story.

I wouldnt reccommend this place to anyone unless you like dealing with stress.

reviews.author: bobbygarzaaz
reviews.review_text: I have lived here for 2 yrs. ever since Richdale took over service in the front office has gone south. I'm getting additional charges for overage on water, I'm usually at the apartment 3 days out of the week at best. Also A/C went out on June 1, 2011, its now June 14th and still not fixed. Manager WILL NOT do anything about it and went I call corporate they refer me to the worthless manager. They are also remodeling the apartments and letting contractors in and out of the apartment as they please and I've been ripped off with over $15,000 worth of my personal belonging!

reviews.author: Current Resident 177220
reviews.review_text: It's in a great location-close to just about everything you need! We do get T1 internet connection-just because that's what we ordered from our company.  I wish we could get the local channels without having to buy an antennae.  The people are friendly..we got a great price on the lease! The only thing wrong is that we turned in a few things before we moved in to get fixed and they said they'd get right on it, but they haven't yet.

reviews.author: Current Resident 499740
reviews.review_text: This has to be the worse apartment complex I have ever lived at. Apartment wasn't ready on move in day. Staff is very unprofessional. There is no priority on getting maintenance orders done at an adequately time.

reviews.author: atltophx
reviews.review_text: Moved in not to long ago.  The place is OK.  There were several problems with the apartment when we moved in and we are still waiting to have them fixed.  The place is actually a bit noisy with people yelling and actually barking....or there is loud music playing.  I was in a hurry and new to the area so I guess it could have been much worse.  Office staff is nice but not very informative...maybe not that knowledgeable.  Was also told that the internet connection was a T1 and turned out to be DSL...not very good.  I think overpriced for what you get.

reviews.author: Current Resident 544834
reviews.review_text: Not worth the living....the staff and maintenance is not helpful at all.  It is very noisy and can hear everything above you and around you.  The maintenance is very slow. If I put in a request it will take 2-3 weeks to get your request done and the staff is rude.  The assistant manager doesn't know what their doing and just follows what authority tells them and not try to be cooperative.  They will charge you extra fees that you didn't even know about and they will never contact you about it.  They never contact you when they say they will and they are always short staffed.  Every time I go in the office to pick up a package or drop something off I have to wait for 15 minutes and there is a huge line. Bridge property is very rude and just wants the money.  They don't care if you have problems with your apartment.  You signed the lease so you have to deal with it.  It is just not peaceful place to live.

reviews.author: Current Resident 650459
reviews.review_text: The apartment looks really nice with upgraded appliances and cabinets, but that's about it. When I had sewage back up into my kitchen sink and dishwasher, no one came out to take a look because it eventually drained back but not after spilling out over the counter top and on the floor. 3 months of complaints about the upstairs neighbors being loud, walking heavily and sounds of dropping large objects well into the night have not resulted in anything. Tenants still continue with the noise.

Again, thanks for your review and if you have any further questions, stop by the front office.

reviews.author: Current Resident 158204
reviews.review_text: I love living in this community. The staff are very friendly and helpful, the grounds are always clean and the residents all have a sense of pride for where we live. I don't have any complaints at all. I have lived here over a year and was happy to renew my lease.

reviews.author: Current Resident 122003
reviews.review_text: Wanted to review elliots crossing after my second year here. I have not had any major issues to report, just minor things here and there - nothing I haven t come to expect after 10 years living in apartments. Unlike a couple reviews before me, I do think Tyler is doing a decent job, although he could probably use some extra help. He seems too busy for his own good sometimes. MY apartment is nice and has been since I moved in. The price is good for the amount of space and I get to look out at the pool from my balcony. I think management knows some things that would make this property better; hopefully they make some changes and stop focusing on attracting the new renters, but keeping us current, paying residents here and happy.

reviews.author: nicole1979
reviews.review_text:

Mind you it was 106 outside.  The hot tub is almost always broken as well.

Due to the leak, I have had to deal with the staff on a fairly regular basis.  They really couldn't care less.  One of the staff, a girl by the name of -------, told me that they would fix it when they got to it.  She is very rude and unprofessional on a daily basis.  They often lock up early and are just generally unaccomadating.

They could be really nice apartments if they were under different management.  My suggestion is to skip over this place until a new crew is running the show.

They always came right away, and they always asked if there was anything else that I needed.  They even left lollipops! Now, the new maintenance staff that they have is either unwilling or unable to fix problems, and it takes them DAYS to get here. I will be looking for a diffent place.  That is too bad.  It use to be nice.

My apartment was not ready when I wanted to move in. I came from out of town so that was frustrating 
 I could tell they quickly finished what they could do I could move in. I was told only some have microwaves and mine didn't , which feels unfair. Neighborhood is quiet. Close to the freeway.
reviews.response_text: Dear Resident, we appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts. We're excited to have you as a resident and hope we have the opportunity to address some of the mentioned concerns. Please visit our office when you have a chance, we look forward to improving your experience at our community.

reviews.author: Current Resident 855282
reviews.review_text: We have lived at Pinnacle Grove for six months. Bridge Property Management took over the property shortly after we moved in.  There have been many recent upgrades to the property such as a pool renovation, new dog park (which appears to be popular with the residents), new exterior paint, recently planted flowerbeds/desert landscaping, and repaired/replaced complex lighting to name a few.  As to be expected with any change, not all aspects of the transition have been smooth but there have been many nice changes at the property.  I suspect that the reviews of this property will continue to improve as other improvements are completed.  Positives of the community are that some really nice people live here (we have some great neighbors), the units themselves are large and have a lot of storage compared to some of the neighboring properties; we especially like the in-unit washer/dryer and ceiling fans.  We toured some of the neighboring properties and found Pinnacle Grove to be a good value in terms of rental cost in relation to included amenities/apt. square footage.  Plus, the location is centrally located to many valley fun spots.

reviews.author: Current Resident 241232
reviews.review_text: Elliot's Crossing Apartment is located at very useful ad efficient spot. It's close to mall, grocery, Costco, Wal-Mart, School, Business District, and Sport centers. The people from leasing office are so friendly and helpful. Quiet place as well.
reviews.response_text: Thank you for writing us this positive review of Elliot's Crossing! It is a joy to read that you are enjoying our convenient and peaceful location, and our kind office staff. Not only do we strive to be kind but professional as well. We hope these aspects of our community continue to benefit you during your stay. Don't be afraid to stop by the office if you ever need assistance with something.

reviews.author: Current Resident 155705
reviews.review_text: Love my home. Concerns always addressed in a timely fashion. Office staff delightful and go out of their way to please. The only thing that has gone unanswered is the lack of landscaping outside my home. I have not mentioned this before but the trash area is almost always overflowing.
reviews.response_text: Thank you for your four-star rating of Elliot's Crossing Apartments. We appreciate the kind words about our attentive office staff that goes above and beyond to please our residents. We hope that this will continue to happen and would love to hear any suggestions you may have about landscaping. We will look into getting the trash area cleaned up so our community looks nice and beautiful for you. Please feel free to discuss any concerns in more detail by seeing us in the office.

reviews.author: Current Resident 155677
reviews.review_text: I moved here right after they bought Pinnacle Grove property, so the transition was a little rough, but I do recommend it here. The office staff are friendly & professional but the communication b/w maintenance & office needs improvement.

reviews.author: Current Resident 21470
reviews.review_text:

In short, the living experience at the Crossings is less pleasant than sodomy and mass genocide combined.

THEY couldn't pay ME to live here for another ------- day. The price we pay gets us ---- here. They don't even spend our money on worthwhile things. Instead of upgrading the hardware or replacing the carpets, they paint the exterior, build a model apartment in the front of the the complex to make it look better than it really is.

Do Not Rent Here!!!!!!!!!

My dryer was not working, I tried all settings and it could not fully dry a half load of clothing. 
I opened a ticket online. I received no response until I called in a full week later. I'm told somebody will come by on either Friday or Sunday. So A guy comes by on Sunday to tell me they need a part and nothing gets fixed and the supervisor would be there first thing on Monday. Monday comes and goes I get home from work and nobody has come by, I call the office and I'm told a halfhearted sorry and they say they'll have somebody come by first thing the next day. A guy comes by sometime midday and cleans out the lint trap and tells me its working. It does not work still. At this point I email Bridge corporate and I get called by Tyler who promises me everything will be fixed and they'll have a guy there first thing in the morning to fix it. I take a day off so I can be there to make sure it gets taken care of. 
Nobody shows up I get a call at around three telling me that they can't come over and they'll be there tomorrow. 

They find a problem with the vent and that doesn't resolve it so they replace the dryer. More than 14 days have now passed I'm legally allowed to call a third party and have them fix it but I continue to work with the site maintenance. 

I run the new dryer on the 'Timed Automatic' setting with a towel and three shirts. It takes four cycles to dry the towel completely. At this point I'm told that I should use the onsite laundry and I will be reimbursed for any money I put on a laundry card. I put 10 dollars on the card and I'm told that they will reimburse me for the that and 'some extra reimbursement for all the trouble I've had' 

I am considering breaking my lease at this point because I have had this apartment for less than a month, but the promise of making it right with credits to my account actually makes me feel a lot better. 
They have another guy come in and it turns out the "timed Automatic" setting does not seem to work as advertised, however the regular timed mode works so I can dry my clothing. I had tried this setting on the first dryer BEFORE I submitted a maintenance request and it did not work so I assumed this one had the same issue. 

Now weeks later I get my monthly charges and No credits have been applied to my account. This is just a stream of broken promises that really set a negative precedent for the rest of my time here.

Okay, so full disclosure, I just signed my second year with Elliot's Crossing and think you should hear what it is like here, both the pros and the cons.  

First off, the grounds are very well kept.  Currently, they are remodeling a lot of apts to add a washer and dyer so some areas are under construction.  At least they are trying to add value to the property.  

The reviews of the office staff are mainly true.  I never really have an issue with them as I pay my rent on time, and typically just don't go in the office.  However, the one time i had an issue, i went to the office to speak with them about it. They could do nothing.  I needed to contact corporate to have a basic problem solved.  This seemed like a bit of a pain, given i was looking at someone i thought could help me.  I mean, they can take my money, but can't help me? Come on....

The apartments:
They are in good shape.  Nothing fancy, by any stretch, but they are nice.  I really like my one bedroom.  They are currently raising the rents on all apartments and we are seeing a mass exit of some really great people. I just don't understand (outside of greed) why you would raise a single income families rent on a small 2 bedroom $180/mo in this economy.  

The community:
LIke all complexes, you have the trash, but you also have some great people.  I have made new friends that i will have for life in this complex and we all enjoy the pool in the warmer months.  I feel safe at night, and am close to what i need. 

My advice:
Understand that this place is a business, not a charity.  Their job in the front is to sell you an apartment, nothing more.  TO the person that was upset about them asking his monthly payment requirements....well yea jackass, i wouldn't want to spend my time with you if you can't afford the apartment either. It is called qualifying, it is sales 101, read a book. 

I hope the folks that own this complex now don't continue to up rent on everyone.  The apartment i am in is perfect for what i pay, but to add $100/mo to it would just be silly.  The market value in the area may be more, but those complexes are newer and much nicer...know your limitations and keep your current tenants happy. 

Anyway, check out the complex, it really is a good place to live in Tempe...Hope to see ya around the pool.

reviews.author: Former Resident 33759
reviews.review_text: I've lived in several apartments since college and this is by far the worst experience I've had in my life. Maintenance has been great here, but management needs considerable work. I complained for over 3 months about my loud downstairs neighbor to management, but unfortunately the issue was never resolved. I had a meeting with the property manager of the apartment complex, Rosanne, but she told me that they need evidence of the loud neighbor in order for them to take legal action against them. Management waited over 3 months to tell me they couldn't do anything about the issue without evidence. There's definitely a lack of communication with their residents. I can't even count the number of times I've emailed the apartment office, but they completely ignored/disregarded my messages. Not only does this demonstrate indifference, but it's unprofessional as well. This is not management's only shortcoming. They deceived me on multiple occasions in the office. I never received a fitness center key when I moved in, so I went down to the office to request a key. The lady down at the office told me the assistant manager, Trystan, would be making more keys and they would be sending out a mass email to residents. Well, that never happened. Also, I went down to the office to complain about my loud neighbor in person and they told me they would be taking legal action against them. Again, this is another lie the office artificially created for me to leave them alone. I believe this apartment complex is extremely unfit for the job of caring for their residents. They're basically managing two apartment complexes in one, but they won't hire more staff. I finally gave up with this apartment complex and broke my lease contract. They tried convincing me to transfer to another unit, but they wanted to raise my rent to close to $1000. I was happy with paying $858, but I couldn't put up with that irritating neighbor any longer. It was already an inconvenience for me to have to move all of my stuff into another apartment, but they wanted to charge me extra rent as well. This apartment complex simply isn't worth your time and money. You would have a better experience paying just a little bit more for a higher end complex. I moved out of this apartment complex on February 15th 2020. I received my final move out statement from Elliot's Crossing in the mail 3 weeks later. They're now trying to nickel and dime me for anything they thought wasn't absolutely perfect in my apartment. I'm being charged for them to retouch up the paint in my apartment even though I thought it was fine. I don't have any children or pets. Here's my advice. Take many pictures of the apartment on move-in day. Take time filling out the move-in damage paperwork. Insist upon a walkthrough of the apartment with management on move-out day. Also, take a lot of pictures of the apartment's condition on move-out day. This may help when they have exaggerated claims of damages to the apartment. Believe me, they will try to chisel you out of all the money you have. I gave a 60 day notice that I was moving. I paid 2 months base rent (approximately $1750) to break the lease. I had to forfeit a $99 non-refundable deposit. They charged me an additional $273 on move-out for shampooing the bedroom carpet (the only room that was carpeted), touch up paint and clean up. I've never had to pay this much on move-out before. I left the apartment absolutely spotless. I strongly believe that had I given them the standard $500 deposit, they would have invented $500 worth of move out costs. Keep in mind, I lived in this complex for 5 and a half months. In total, I spent in excess of $2000 getting out of this dump.

reviews.author: ubermonkey
reviews.review_text: I've lived here since 2007 so I've seen a lot of change over the years! First let me hit a few of the good things: 1. Super convenient - nearby are Walmart, Safeway, CVS, QT, Circle K, Arby's, BK, McDonald's, Wendy's, Panda Exp, Subway, Starbucks, Fuddruckers, Taco Bell, Red Robin, Sonic, Popeye's, Oregano's and even more food joints. There's also a Costco and one of those car wash/oil change megaplex things. AND access to the I-10 AND the 60 less than 3 miles away. 2. Nice grills, gym, decent pool (not Olympic but it's clean and usable), onsite laundry and 'business office' with computers - and a clubhouse which has a pool table -honestly the clubhouse is not really the kind you'd rent out for a party or anything but I'm not sure how important that is for most people... 3. Enough parking so you don't have to park on the street, ever. 4. In the 11 years I've been here I've seen a handful of police related calls. Put hundreds of people from everywhere together and incidents will happen but I've seen less of that here than anywhere else. My car has never been broken in to, and the grounds are well lit. Now, let me give you the low down that might speak to a few of the issues I've seen other reviewers mention: Friendliness of office staff - seriously I have never had them be rude to me. That's probably because I've worked customer service and I realize that every apt staff has more to do than they can handle so I'm patient and nice. That's my big secret. I stand in line a little longer or sometimes even have to come back the next day..but when I have a really big issue and raise my voice a bit they know it's out of character and they help me out...(and in the course of 11 years everyone will have something happen!) Stuff breaking down - well yeah...talk to a home owner, stuff breaks. Take care of your apt as much as you can; don't treat it like a rental car (in fact don't treat your rental cars like a rental either will ya?!? It's wasteful.) Want it fixed? Go to the office and be nice; being a tenant doesn't give you the right to treat the employees like minions. Bugs - I've lived all over the US, most recently in New Orleans, the roach capital of the US, so I feel qualified to talk about this. First I live on the top floor, honestly that helps a lot. But I've seen two cockroaches and one silverfish since 2007 (that's 11 years!) Here's the deal; don't leave dirty dishes or half full beverages around, and if you have a pet clean it's litter box or pick up it's poo and take it to the dumpster. It's really that simple. Speaking of dog owner who let their dogs go everywhere and don't clean it up...that irritates me a lot! The apt complex has put pet trash cans with plastic bag dispensers all over and there's also a couple dog parks and somehow people are still so lazy they let their dogs go and don't clean it up - even though they're 20' from the can...I don't know how that's the apartment's fault..they've got the lawn service out there several times a week! It's probably a little unfair of me to say this but I seriously think some folks must be used to living with their parents and being catered to... It's like they think since they're paying everything should be taken care of without any effort on their part and it should be done instantly. People like this are the same ones who don't pick up after their dogs or clean up after themselves after using the grills...can't say I'm sad when they move out ;) If that sounds harsh, please feel free to skip living here - if you're one of the good ones who don't think all that's unreasonable - welcome, it's a great place!

reviews.author: Current Resident 335850
reviews.review_text:
Do yourself a favor and just don't move here. My problems started immediately upon moving in. My apartment was NOT move in ready- there was a cabinet completely hanging off its hinge, one of the window screens had fallen off and was just sitting on the patio, and the apartment was dirty. The doors barely opened and closed because of the built up paint, and the deadbolt did not work. There was also no washer and dryer, which was the only reason I had picked this complex over several others I had been to. The management apologized, and said everything would be fixed asap and I would have my washer and dryer within the week. Thankfully most of it was fixed promptly (new locks were put on the door, new window screen, fixed the cabinet). However I did not get my washer and dryer for THREE MONTHS! Not only that, but I was blatantly lied to by the employees in the office, who told me each time I'd call (at least once a week), that they were getting the new washers and dryers in within the next week. That was until I got someone new on the phone, who finally told me that there was a waiting list, and it would be at LEAST another month and a half before I received my washer and dryer. I was not told this before or during my move in. 

About a week after I moved in, the paint, or whatever substance that they had used to paint the bathtub (yes... they PAINTED the bathtub) started to flake off, clogging my tub drain, and revealing two huge disgusting dark brown circles about 6 in in diameter each on the bottom of the tub. Despite using bleach to try and clean these spots, they were obviously stained into the tub. I cannot even describe how disgusting the bottom of the tub looked- it was obvious why they had attempted to paint it. When I reported this to management, they said that I would not be charged for the dirty spots upon moving out because I had reported them right away (?!?!), and there was nothing they were going to do because it was normal wear and tear. Needless to say I never took a bath in that tub. 

The BEST part about my experience at Elliot's Crossing was the certified eviction notification I received from their corporate office a month after moving in, stating that if I did not pay over $800 in late fees, that I would be evicted 5 days after the letter was dated (which happened to be the very next day). I had paid my rent and all fees on time, so had no idea what this letter was regarding. But since they were supposedly going to evict me the next day, I panicked. I called the contact # at the corporate office multiple times with no answer, and when no one had called me back 2 hours later, I left work and went to the management office. After looking into the issue, they had apparently not applied my move-in discount. The girl in the front office barely batted an eyelash at the situation like it was no big deal!  

After ALL of this, I called their corporate office to voice my frustration. I asked to be compensated for the three months I was without the washer and dryer I was paying for (and for having to pay to wash my clothes at a laundry facility), and the few hours that I had to miss work to deal with their "oops" eviction notice. Their "resident relations specialist" was possibly one of the rudest people I have ever spoken to. She decided to point out to me that there is no separate charge for the washers and dryers (good to know that Elliot's Crossing gives people free w/ds! Good thing the residents don't have to pay for them!), that it was my decision to take my laundry off-site (because doing laundry is a choice?!), and, my personal favorite, "Our letter didn't tell you to leave work and drive down to our office."   I was speechless. 

But good news! After mentioning my frustration with my experience to one of the new front office girls while picking up a package, she offered me a free parking spot (have I mentioned the parking lot off of Grove Parkway sucks? Good luck getting one of the 10 open spots...). One month after receiving this free parking spot, a notice for a failure to pay for this spot was posted to my door, along with the late fees I was going to be charged if they did not receive payment...

Needless to say, I submitted my notice to move out over two months early. With glee.
